events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years, Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th today. What's your favourite tune from the man himself, whether it's Oasis or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975, promoting the compilation album Shaved Fish.

angles.name: Imagine UK Single
angles.copy: Forty-one years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Anniversary of the first iPod launch
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the original iPod, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before smartphones? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed everything. Did you have one of the originals, or were you late to the party?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred... it's James Bond Day! Which 007 film is your all-time favourite, and who's the best Bond in your book?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: A true visionary and musical legend, John Lennon would have turned 86 today. His legacy of peace and incredible music lives on. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, the legendary John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Anniversary of The Beatles' "White Album"
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," was officially released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album' on the world. A masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your standout track from this legendary record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Anniversary of The Beatles' "Rubber Soul"
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed their sound forward. What are your favourite tracks from this influential record?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, and the world still mourns John Lennon. His music and message of peace remain as powerful as ever. Share your thoughts on his enduring legacy.
